title: Typed File Input + Preview
prompt: Build an avatar uploader with a typed file input and an image preview. **Requirements:** 1. Import `useEffect`, `useState`, and `ChangeEvent` from `react`. 2. Export a function component `AvatarUpload({ onChange }: { onChange?: (file: File | null) => void })`. 3. Inside: - Hold `file` state typed `File | null`. - Hold `previewUrl` state typed `string | null`. - When `file` changes, call `URL.createObjectURL(file)` to set `previewUrl` and call the optional `onChange(file)` prop. In the effect cleanup, call `URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl)` to release the blob. 4. The `onChange` of `` accepts `ChangeEvent` and reads `e.target.files?.[0] ?? null`. 5. Render the input plus, when `previewUrl` is non-null, an ``.
hints: `e.target.files` is a `FileList | null`; index `[0]` and fall back to `null`.
Always revoke the object URL in the cleanup -- otherwise the blob lingers in memory.
Drive the preview from a `useEffect` keyed on `file` so the URL is created exactly once per pick.
